current.text: Charlotte got him from Phoenix in the Miles Bridges trade, along with Grayson Allen.
He is a bench player in Charlotte. The projected bench is Allen, Schröder, Steinbach, O'Neale and Grant Williams.
He may get more power forward minutes, but he is not worth drafting.
Charlotte has a deep roster and projects as a play-in team. That spreads the bench minutes.
Charlotte plans to space the floor and take a lot of threes.
With the March 28 end date, Charlotte plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks. It has 13 back-to-backs, the league minimum.

durable.text: He made corner threes all season long.
Threes are his only clear fantasy strength. He scores little and his FG% is below average.
He showed signs of decline, and teams around the league saw his contract as a negative asset.

note: Both Yahoo (rank 209) and ESPN (rank 157) value him at 0 USD. The only expert call says he is undraftable, so leave him out of our 144-player auction. His one real category is threes (about 2.3 per game as a forward), and he gives back FG% and points, so he is at most a short-term waiver add for a team that needs threes. Early on, check whether the absences of Coby White and Kon Knueppel or the open power forward minutes push him clearly above his projected 24.5 minutes.
